attribution: International Commission on Illumination (CIE), official datasets: CIE 1931 colour-matching functions, 2 degree observer; CIE standard illuminant D65.

tables.modifications: None to CSV bytes. Runtime 5 nm path selects every fifth original row; 1 nm reference uses original rows. Piecewise-linear CMFs integrate finite-volume cell data.

tables.units: relative spectral distribution; runtime label relative nm^-1, not SI irradiance
tables.modifications: None to CSV bytes. Relative material normalization uses the chosen observer integration grid. D65 is never extended beyond 830 nm.
tables.sourceMetadataNotice: Official SPD-column metadata says 360–830 nm but wavelength-column metadata and actual CSV span 300–830 nm. Original bytes retained; color integration uses only 360–830 nm.

authoredSource.processing: Constant per-nm source normalized using trapezoidal CIE 1 nm ybar integral over 360–830 nm. Authored extended-band source; not a D65 measurement or extrapolation.

displayReference: Fixed sRGB D65 white x=0.3127, y=0.3290; source chromaticity retained, no automatic chromatic adaptation.
